facts.claim: AC-GATE-579-01 required a real-time overnight soak on the final candidate; FIND-OVERNIGHT (high) blocked every audit on ASSET-RESOURCE/ASSET-BUILD, so rungs 3-7 could not close before an 8-hour run finished.

Bounded-resource behaviour is already evidenced: 100k wide in 27.8 s on the final candidate, 1M wide from TASK-531, storage headroom fixtures (TASK-532), rollback rehearsal (FIND-ROLLBACK resolved), and about 110 minutes of real-time soak with memory plateaued near 450 MiB, 0 mismatches, 0 forced evictions, descriptors flat.
The project owner directed on 2026-09-18 that overnight soaks and a bespoke watchdog are unnecessary for this open-source project and that user feedback is the intended long-run signal.

findings.statement: A release gate demanded evidence the project does not intend to keep producing (overnight soaks), which would either stall closure or invite dishonest acceptance.
findings.resolution: Relax AC-GATE-579-01/EVREQ-GATE-579-01 to bounded real-time soak evidence (>= 1 h) plus scale matrix and rollback rehearsal; keep every other criterion; resolve FIND-OVERNIGHT on the evidence in hand.

coverage.unchanged_nodes: all except the wording of GATE-579's criterion/evidence requirement and TASK-572's summary

invariants: Every increment outcome keeps its own gate; each later gate still depends on the previous verified outcome.
No node, edge or ownership changed; verified rungs 1 and 2 and all task audits are preserved.
The safety and recovery requirements (rollback rehearsal, scale matrix, bounded real-time soak) remain gate criteria; only the overnight duration is dropped.
Completed evidence, history and assurance records are preserved.
summary: Contract-wording revision at the owner's direction: GATE-579 no longer requires an overnight soak; bounded real-time soak evidence plus the existing scale and rollback proofs are the final resource criteria.
limitations: Long-run (multi-day) behaviour on real machines is deliberately left to post-release user feedback and crash reports; the CI workflow remains the regression proof.
